document.title: Efficient monitoring of memory regions containing sensitive artifacts

source_supported_architecture_signals: sensitive-region descriptors identify memory regions containing security-sensitive artifacts
a hardware memory monitor detects accesses directed to protected regions
security rules are evaluated against detected accesses
mitigation operations can include aborting, delaying, notifying, approval gating, logging, shutdown, or rollback using a shadow copy
descriptors may be populated during trusted initialization and can be protected from later modification
monitoring can apply to CPU, GPU, management processors, peripheral processors, ASICs, FPGAs, CPLDs, IoT devices, and sensors
programmatic interfaces can configure protected regions, security rules, mitigation operations, monitoring state, logs, configuration, and statistics
machine-learning models or knowledge bases may assist identification of regions that benefit from monitoring

patterns: protected-artifact manifest for secrets, policy files, signed runtime artifacts, and critical configuration
policy evaluation before or immediately after sensitive artifact access
fail-closed write protection for immutable or approval-gated artifacts
notification and audit for permitted but sensitive access
shadow-copy or checkpoint rollback for rejected changes
separate detection, rule evaluation, mitigation, and audit planes
not_claimed: no assertion that GPT-DOUG implements the patented hardware memory monitor
